page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre; page number top right. Main text in one column with Greek and Latin paragraphs, headings centred. Marginal words at right ("Vade", "Vadere", "Vado", "Medium", "Imperf.") sit in the right margin beside the text.

main_text.p: ἴτε καὶ ὕστερον εἶδα δοὰς ὅτι νῆας ἀχαιῶν.ὀδυσ. τ.
ἢ τάχα καὶ δαλῶ βεβλημένῳ εἶδα Ἰυεαζε. hoc est, ibis. ὃ ἰλιάδ. σ.
ἂψ πάλιν εἰσ᾽ ὅτι νῆας. id est, ibit.
main_text.head: IMPERATIVVS.
main_text.p: Ἴθι ἴτω D. ἴτον ἴτων Pl. ἴτε ἴτωσαν. Vade. Pro Ἴθι etiam dicitur εἶ, ab ἔω εἶς per Synerefin, unde ἴξει apud Aristoph. Ἀλλεῖ. Optatiuo & Subiunctiuo deficit.
main_text.head: INFINITIVVS.
main_text.p: ἴναι, Dorice ἰμμεναι, Ion. ἰμμεν uel etiam εἶ. Vadere Vnde παρεῖναι adire. ἀπεῖναι abire, quæ uerbo substantiuo coincidunt.
ἐπεὶ πολὺ φέρτερον ὄζιν οἰκαδ᾽ ἰμμεν.
main_text.l: Præsens sing. ἵημι ἵης ἵησι. Vado.
main_text.head: MEDIVM.
main_text.l: ἱέμην ἵεσο ἵετο καὶ τὰ λοιπά. Imperf.

page.notes: Marginal words at right are printed notes. Greek text is transcribed as far as legible; some accents and breathings are uncertain. The Greek line beginning "ἔπει" and some letters in the Greek forms are doubtful. The "p" below the last line is a printed signature-like mark.
